description: This file defines the 'tlCodeTracker' class, which manages code tracking systems within the TestLink project. It includes methods for system retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, linking to test projects, and configuration validation.

classes.name: tlCodeTracker
classes.description: A class for managing code tracker systems within the TestLink testing platform, providing CRUD operations, linking to projects, and environment checks.

methods.name: getSystems
methods.description: Returns systems with optional filtering by enabled/disabled status.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of system types with interface info.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Returns implementation class name for a given system type.

methods.name: getEntitySpec
methods.description: Returns the entity specification array.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new code tracker entry after validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing code tracker entry after validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a code tracker if not linked to projects.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves a code tracker by its ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a code tracker by its name.

methods.name: getByAttr
methods.description: General method to get a code tracker by attribute.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and minor checks on input object.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Creates a link between a code tracker and a test project.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes a link between a code tracker and a test project.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Retrieves test projects linked to a specific code tracker.

methods.name: getLinkSet
methods.description: Retrieves all links between code trackers and test projects.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all code trackers with optional filtering and additional info.

methods.name: getLinkedTo
methods.description: Returns detailed info about the test project linked to a code tracker.

methods.name: getInterfaceObject
methods.description: Returns interface object for a linked code tracker, with optional session caching.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks if the connection to the code tracker is active.

methods.name: checkXMLCfg
methods.description: Validates XML configuration string.
